name: Transport and Logistics
description: Starter pack for transport and fleet operations: vehicle inspections, maintenance intervals, driver compliance and registrations.

definitions.title: Daily pre-trip inspection log
definitions.note: Complete and file the pre-trip inspection for every vehicle.
steps: Walk around and check tires and lights

definitions.title: Daily post-trip inspection log
definitions.note: File post-trip checks and report any defect found.

definitions.title: Weekly tire and fluid check
definitions.note: Check tire pressure, tread and fluid levels across the fleet.

definitions.title: Monthly vehicle maintenance service
definitions.note: Perform scheduled maintenance and file the service records.

definitions.title: Monthly fuel and mileage report
definitions.note: Compile fuel use and mileage per vehicle and flag outliers.

definitions.title: Quarterly driver license check
definitions.note: Verify every driver's license and medical certificate status.

definitions.title: Quarterly insurance certificate review
definitions.note: Check insurance certificates for all vehicles and trailers.

definitions.title: Registry filings and abstracts
definitions.note: File annual registry forms and driver abstracts.

definitions.title: Hazardous materials training refresher
definitions.note: Run the annual hazmat and safety refresher and file attendance.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc breakdown report
definitions.note: Breakdown or defect report - set the due date when creating it.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc route change
definitions.note: Temporary route change or detour planning.
